title: brand_lint.json
description: brand_lint lexicons + word charclass + messages (plan §2.2). Translator-owned. At runtime ACRONYMS = shared/slop_en_core.json core ∪ fiscal.acronyms_fiscal ∪ brand_lint.acronyms_extra. word_charclass MUST include the language's accented letters so the tokenizer doesn't drop them (FR œàâçèéêëîïôùûü, NL ëïöü). Mechanical-rule data (stopwords / leak_denylist / register / passive_patterns / pressure) imported from dynapps-voice draft 2026-07-17: ALL language data lives here, never in the engine.

_comment.description: Provenance note (e.g. imported voice-guide version stamp).

acronyms_extra.description: Extra allowed acronyms beyond shared core + fiscal. es=[].

stopwords.description: ~50 common function words of THIS pack's language. The engine aggregates every pack's set to profile the dominant language of a prose field (IDIOMA check).

leak_denylist.description: Literal giveaways of a FOREIGN language (today: common Spanish phrases) that must never appear in this pack's prose. es=[].

avoid.description: Regex (matched on normalized lowercase text) for a banned register token, e.g. nl '\\bu\\b'.

register.description: Banned register tokens (REGISTRO check). nl: u/uw -> je/jij; fr: tu/ton/ta -> vous/votre. es=[] by product decision.

passive_patterns.description: Passive-voice heuristic regexes, matched on the accent-stripped lowercase text. WARN-only. es=[] by product decision.

pressure.description: Sales-pressure/urgency phrase lexicon (PRESION check): urgency must read as planning transparency.

word_charclass.description: Regex charclass for word tokenization, es='A-Za-zÁÉÍÓÚÜÑáéíóúüñ0-9./-'.
